content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result: missing — inserted new Section 10.3 at the preferred position.**

- **Investigation:** Section 10 (10.1–10.2) only ends access "after any agreed transition period" and addresses Deliverables/refunds; Section 15 covers processing limits but no return/export/deletion; Section 16.5 returns only Confidential Information and defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15 — Section 11 does not exist. No transition-assistance or data-return obligation exists anywhere, so even the fallback fails and the walk-away risk (no data return) is live.
- **Cure:** One inserted clause carrying exactly the six preferred elements — assistance on expiry or termination for up to six months at then-current rates, Customer Data returned in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return (not merely after assistance). No survival tails, procedures, or other non-element boilerplate added, and no neighbouring text rewritten.
